list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on all 55). The game released 19 November 2026. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours to the platinum, Push Square 250+ hours; one trophy is possibly missable. TrueTrophies and PSNProfiles count 28 hidden; Push Square's guide marks 27 (it does not mark Personal Best hidden).
method: Guides in our own words, each citing its sources. 'reported' means the method is confirmed by the named launch guide (PowerPyx, Push Square or GTABase, all published at launch on 18-19 November 2026). 'official-description' means the advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in play. 'unconfirmed' means PowerPyx lists the trigger as currently unknown. Difficulty 1-5 and time are this guide's own estimates, built from PowerPyx's roadmap (story 60-80 hours, 100% cleanup about 100 hours, strands and cleanup about 10 hours). Cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving (PowerPyx and Push Square): keep them off the file you use for the platinum.

EXO.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (official list: names, descriptions, grades)

PPYX.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

PSN.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (grades and PSN progress targets)

PSQ.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

SIX.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: All 55, Missables and Roadmap

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx confirms it needs no multiplayer and no DLC, and rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours (Push Square says 250+). Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap, not a task of its own. One warning for the whole run: cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving, so keep them off this save file.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Follow the roadmap stages in this guide: story, 100% checklist, then strands and cleanup.
Never turn cheats on in this save file.

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players will earn — just play the story from the start and it unlocks when the mission ends. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed. There are no mission medals this time, so play it however you like.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end — PowerPyx notes the chapter trophies pop a little late, and this one lands after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might matter: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions in order.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and this pops — PowerPyx says it lands just after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City', so do not worry if it does not fire the instant the chapter ends. Automatic, cannot be missed. Chapter 2 is also when Jason and Lucia can roam together (after 'Coffee Break'), which opens most of the side trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions in order.
After 'Coffee Break', start the side content that needs both characters together.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and this pops — PowerPyx says it lands after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Automatic, cannot be missed. Chapter 3 is where several trophy tools unlock: the Snap Gun (Sneakthief), the Dye Pack Jammer (Dime on the Dollar) and the Key Cloner (Capital Offense, Supply & Demand).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions in order.
Pick up the Snap Gun, Dye Pack Jammer and Key Cloner as the story hands them to you.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this pops — PowerPyx says it lands after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. Automatic, cannot be missed. The same mission also pops the gold final-mission trophy, so the end of Chapter 4 is a double celebration.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions in order.
Finish 'Starting From Zero' — this trophy and the final-mission gold pop together.

trophies.guide: The gold for the final mission. PowerPyx says it unlocks after completing the final main mission, 'Starting From Zero' at the end of Chapter 4. Automatic, cannot be missed — just finish the story. After the credits, free-roam continues and everything needed for 100% is still available, so the platinum run is far from over.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the story through the final mission, 'Starting From Zero'.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and start the cleanup.

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish 'Breakfast Run' in Chapter 2 and it unlocks during the mission. PowerPyx lists it as automatic and impossible to miss — one of six mission trophies spread across the chapters (one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5).
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story mission 'Breakfast Run' to its end.

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish 'The Cartel Heist' in Chapter 3 and it unlocks during the mission. Automatic, cannot be missed (PowerPyx). The heist is one of the Chapter 3 set-pieces — enjoy it; there is no medal to chase and no replay to worry about.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story mission 'The Cartel Heist' to its end.

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish 'Child's Play' in Chapter 4 and it unlocks during the mission. Automatic, cannot be missed (PowerPyx). Chapter 4 holds three of the six mission trophies, so this is the first of a busy chapter.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story mission 'Child's Play' to its end.

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish 'Headliners' in Chapter 4 and it unlocks during the mission. Automatic, cannot be missed (PowerPyx). The second of Chapter 4's three mission trophies.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story mission 'Headliners' to its end.

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish 'VCIA Takedown' in Chapter 4 and it unlocks during the mission. Automatic, cannot be missed (PowerPyx). The third of Chapter 4's three mission trophies — the airport mission, which also teaches you the layout you will use later for Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story mission 'VCIA Takedown' to its end.

trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: finish 'Operation Savage Glory' in Chapter 5 and it unlocks during the mission. Automatic, cannot be missed (PowerPyx). The last of the six mission trophies — one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the Chapter 5 story mission 'Operation Savage Glory' to its end.

trophies.guide: The second gold and the hardest trophy on the list (PowerPyx). The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. Nothing on it is missable — everything is doable in free-roam afterwards. PowerPyx calls it lenient, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions (there are 200-300+), 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 300 stunts. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Push Square adds that 15 of the 18 card sets are needed too. This is the trophy the ~100-hour cleanup stage is about.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every line the checklist shows — it is the authority, not this guide.
Do 100 optional missions, scan 200 vehicles, study 100 animals, and finish 70 of 80 challenges.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — for the 100% checklist you need 300. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, and says the under-bridge flights are the quickest to do. You can mix the four kinds freely. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its own name and marker.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Pick the easiest kind first — PowerPyx says flights under bridges are quickest.
Work through the map region by region; stunts stay marked once done.
Reach 250 for this trophy, then keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. View them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scrolling over each shows how many you have done. PowerPyx says you will do one of each automatically while working on the other trophies, so do not chase this one; just check the list near the end and fill the gap.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities and see which of the 9 types is missing.
Do the missing type once — a round of pool, a hole of golf, one fishing catch.
Most types happen naturally during the story and the 100% cleanup.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 range locations in Leonida (PowerPyx). Gold medals are a skill check, not a grind: learn each challenge's rhythm, use the weapon the challenge gives you, and replay the ones you miss — your best medal per challenge is what counts. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes the Gunslinger trophy easier, so do this work before that one if you are struggling.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a range on the map (Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges) — there are 12 locations.
Play every challenge and chase gold, not just a pass.
Replay missed challenges; your best medal per challenge is what counts.
42 gold medals across the ranges unlocks the trophy.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for this trophy. PowerPyx counts 42 drone races in total across those locations, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so while you are at a location it is worth finishing its other races too rather than coming back later.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun location on the map and enter its drone race.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.
While there, clear the location's remaining races for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need variety, not repeats of one easy win. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in total. Mix car races, race challenges and drone races, and spread them across the playthrough so the wins accumulate naturally.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races from the map and race markers.
Win 20 different ones; repeats of the same race do not count twice.
Drone race wins count too — they can fill gaps.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)', your friend Cal sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there — the challenge is a short fishing contest against him, not a grind. PowerPyx's guide shows the spot and the catch, and it is a quick trophy once the text arrives.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' and wait for Cal's text.
Follow the purple fishing marker on the map.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: There are 4 video games in the game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. To 'complete' one you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat all of its challenges, just reach the end. Pick whichever you like best; the home games are briefly unavailable during some story sections but work again after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: At home, use the TV controllers to start Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind — or find Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine.
Play through all of that game's levels to the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, which marks the questline in Belville. Five quests finish it — 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1-3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label' and 'Puff Puff Pass'. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia until Andy calls and texts her address.
Follow the Belville markers through the five Andy quests.
Finish 'Puff Puff Pass' for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' he calls, then the green 'KR' icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive for the treasures (a metal detector digs them from the ocean floor) and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so he is not missable. Track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: In Chapter 1, do 'Island Dreams' and wait for Kenton's call.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and bring the treasures back to Kenton.
Keep going through all 7 shipwrecks; if he goes quiet, play on — he returns.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five quests finish it — 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' and 'Hometown Heroes'. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After 'Coffee Break', head to the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.
Work through the five Billy quests in order.
Finish 'Hometown Heroes' for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are side quests in the open world — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx is explicit: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as 'strangers' for this trophy. Confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove strand), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), and PowerPyx notes more strangers are yet to be discovered. You can see how many you have completed in the trophy tracker, and all of them are still findable after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Look for stranger icons in the open world — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Finish 8 of the counting strands; the contact questlines do not count here.
Check the trophy tracker to see how many strands are done.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's 'Wish List' is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered. Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List — he marks some in fixed locations and more as you complete them, and he is the green 'RK' icon in the west of Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage; a car delivered in good condition pays more. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's list.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to find the 16 he wants.
Deliver all 16 to Randy's garage in Vice City.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty', and is only available as Jason. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them in the quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter'. After enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, 'Spin On This', which unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story. Note: Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After 'Here, Kitty Kitty', follow the purple Synthetic Lab markers as Jason.
Destroy the labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter'.
Finish the follow-up quest 'Spin On This' for the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each one — doing a spot with both counts as +2 meditations at the same place. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. This is the ONE trophy that may be missable: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her and accept the optional quest — she shows you how it works. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, it raises the counter by one, and it is not marked as a meditation spot like the others, so it is still unclear whether the trophy needs it. PowerPyx did it and then earned the trophy; do it when it comes up and the risk is gone. The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of the 18, so the missable one cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after 'Down to Earth': in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots — with both Jason and Lucia at each one where you can.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations for what is left.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break': playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)', in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). During that first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69', retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Afterwards he marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. There are 15 Target Decks in total (Map > Activities > Target Deck), and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this should come naturally along the way. Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After 'Coffee Break', wait for Bret's text as Jason and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back to him.
Clear all 15 Target Decks — that covers the 100% requirement too.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. Three sets is the trophy; the 100% checklist asks for more (Push Square says 15 of the 18 sets), so card hunting does not end here. PowerPyx's guide maps all 18 sets — work through them region by region and let the checklist count them.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
steps: Find collectible cards while exploring — they sit in fixed spots across Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets for this trophy.
Keep going toward 15 of 18 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding Up and then R1. PowerPyx counts the kinds: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — and there are more than 100 in total, so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Scan whatever you pass: landmarks on the skyline, curiosities on the street, sculptures in plazas. This overlaps with Whip It Good (vehicles) and the 100% checklist, so scan early and often.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan objects with R1 as you explore.
Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count.
Reach 100 scanned locations — there are more than 100, so any 100 will do.

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in the game and you only need 50 for this trophy — for the 100% checklist you need any 70 of 80, so this pops automatically on the way there, and you can skip the hardest 10. View and track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; save this for one of your last trophies, then pick the easiest and quickest of what remains.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and see what is already done.
Clear the easiest 50 first.
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Get a 4-star wanted level (just cause carnage until it climbs), then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works, and PowerPyx's favourite escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red 'heat' wanted zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', since bank vault robberies give 4 stars by themselves.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After 'Coffee Break', call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Raise a 4-star wanted level with your partner along.
Escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel is the easy way out.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between both characters. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) in a row while being chased the whole time — you want to keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs': rob a couple of items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After 'Coffee Break', call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs, healing).
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level.
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; if nothing pops, rob a fourth.

trophies.guide: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The easiest way to 100 is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. You need 200 of the base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — a busy road is fastest.
Scanning is enough; you never need to drive the vehicle.
Reach 100 discovered, then keep going to 200 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health. You must down 5 enemies in one use, and it only lasts a few seconds. Set it up properly: buff your focus first (eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline to extend the window), line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are the reliable target — and work through them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and you will reach level 4 naturally, which makes this easier late in the run.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Raise your Focus level at the shooting ranges and buff it (food, Adrenaline) before the fight.
Find 5+ gang members grouped at a gang operation.
Trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and down all 5 before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to the plane, and take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into it (or walk through the terminal on foot). Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport — the pop is delayed until you are that far out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Drive through an airfield fence to the plane docked at terminal E3/E4.
Board it, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport until it pops.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect a heavy response; this is a smash-and-grab, not a stealth job.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west (Mariana County).
Get into a tank in the south of the base.
Shoot enemies from the tank until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors — it stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping — and it marks jewelry store robberies with green icons in unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm), go to the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick it.
Find the safe-code note, open the safe and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)', which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash in and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag, you cannot carry it all). After that quest you can pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip about security vans (do his earlier quests first, including robbing 2 Payday Loans) — the vans are marked purple; follow them to the bank. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this trophy's 5 is a milestone. Robbing a vault gives an instant 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. A bank pays up to $205,000, the best money in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — the first vault is part of it.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000 each) and follow the vans to banks.
Rob 5 vaults and escape cleanly — then continue to all 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (he becomes a fence in Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist anyway, so this comes on its own if you wait.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Either wait for the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — the vault robbery counts.
Or block an armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius to make it pop.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is a plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. It pairs naturally with the stunt flying and the WAiNK scanning — do it while you are already in the air for Cunning Stunts and You WAiNKer!.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map.
Keep going until no black fog is left anywhere.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you only need one operation belonging to each gang — but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this is the first pass. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find gang illegal operations on the map (yellow icons).
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This trophy is currently unknown: PowerPyx lists it as not yet confirmed, and no launch guide has published a method. The description is all we have — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This guide will not invent a bar, a vendor or a button press for it. Go to the beachfront and look for a cocktail spot when you are there anyway; check back here when a source confirms the trigger. It is a small moment trophy, not a grind, and nothing about it is missable.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and look for a place serving cocktails on the beachfront.
If a prompt or vendor offers a cocktail with a view, take it.
Check back here — this entry will be updated when a source confirms the method.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom's window. Two catches: you can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' — hack into the car first — and it only unlocks from this blue Banshee specifically, not from any other car. It is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed and fires after you drive further away on the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Finish Chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive it forward straight through the window and keep driving.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Despite the name, this is not about bowling a game: it is unlocked by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. The three items are the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling', and it is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy sticky bombs, then go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the watch, the 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun and the safe's contents.
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the getaway, not on the third pickup.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between both characters. Increase strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are many across Vice City) and always go together with your partner (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After 'Coffee Break', buy a fitness club membership.
Always work out with your partner along — both gain strength at once.
Reach maximum strength on Jason and Lucia at the same time.

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. You can see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it is worth turning on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since the police get more aggressive. It comes naturally while you work on the other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. It is not missable, and it is not about one big choice.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings.
Play normally — robberies and encounters all count toward the 500.
Check the trophy's counter in the trophy list if it has not popped by the endgame.

trophies.guide: This trophy is currently unknown: PowerPyx lists it as not yet confirmed and believes it may be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — a belief, not a confirmed method. The description, 'Second time's the charm', is a riddle that does not name a task. This guide will not invent a trigger for it. Play normally and retry what you fail; check back here when a source confirms what actually unlocks it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play normally and retry anything you fail.
Do not chase an unconfirmed method — none is published yet.
Check back here when a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night after 2AM, alone. It is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn: sometimes a blinking car sits at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks. If the car is not there, drive away and come back.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman and return to her car.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This trophy is currently unknown: PowerPyx lists it as not yet confirmed and believes it may come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a belief, not a confirmed method. The description and the in-game hint point at a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but no launch guide has published what actually triggers it. This guide will not present a guess as a method. Try a melee swing from a moving vehicle when the chance comes up, and check back here when a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Keep a melee weapon handy while driving.
Try a melee hit from a moving vehicle when the chance comes up.
Check back here — this entry will be updated when a source confirms the method.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)', which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; you do not need to carry it at once. It comes naturally while you do all the robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…').
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Chapter 3's 'Credit Check' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and bring marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most).
Reach $250,000 laundered in total — bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.guide: Simply spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, since they are the most expensive. PowerPyx counts the shops: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. It comes naturally while you gear up and customise cars — do not save it for a special shopping trip.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items get you there fastest.
Spend across any shops; the total is cumulative.
Reach $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related ones — for this trophy you only need the 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)', when you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone; buy the garages through the app. Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Garages also matter for On the Spot: each one adds parking spots to register vehicles in.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish Chapter 2's 'Daily Driver' to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app ($160,000 total).
The 4 story garages do not count for this trophy.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location wherever you are. To register 10 vehicles you must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes): each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose 'Respray' and then 'Register'. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish Chapter 2's 'Moses' mission to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots for registrations.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and Respray + Register each one.
